newsitem.title: USA: Horizon/CMS sees $43.3 mln charge in Q4.
newsitem.headline: Horizon/CMS sees $43.3 mln charge in Q4.

text.p: Horizon/CMS Healthcare Corp said Monday that it would take a one-time, pre-tax charge of $43.3 million, or $25.1 million net of related tax benefits, in the fourth quarter to end certain pacts with a group of nursing home operators.

Horizon said the pact also includes restructuring and forgiving certain indebtedness from the group, known as the HEA Group, and settling disputes that had arisen between HEA and Horizon's subsidiary, Horizon Facilities Management Inc.

Horizon said $16.5 million in debt owed to it will be repaid over five years with interest at eight percent, with repayment secured by leasehold mortgages on 18 of the HEA Group facilities and a lien on one owned HEA facility.
The company said the agreement with the HEA Group is subject to third party consents but should be consummated before the end of May.
